title: 第 2158 章 以身承法以脊载道承法境第 2157 章 所创之法的逆天之处纹道圆满寿命可达三千年
slug: 儒道至上我在异界背唐诗
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：儒道至上？我在异界背唐诗！第一卷：默认第2158章以身承法，以脊载道，承法境（..la）刹那间，词宋心中所有怅然尽数消散，彻底看清了自家独创大道的真正逆天之处。
正统修行，拼机缘、拼悟性、拼气运、拼苦修，层层桎梏、步步艰难，寿元有限，多数修士终生困于境界，老死道途、抱憾而终。
而他的肉身道纹之法，门槛虽高，却无需争夺天地气运，无需苦修突破境界，只需潜心打磨肉身、铭刻道纹，便能换来数倍于同阶修士的悠长寿命。
对于世间无数困于寿元短板、止步于圣境之前的修士而言，这份逆天馈赠，便是无上机缘、道途曙光，足以让无数天骄摒弃偏见、不畏艰难，倾力修行此法。
想通此间关键，词宋眼底重现澄澈明光，道心愈发笃定通透。
念及此处，词宋心中豁然贯通，结合自身如今圆满的修行状态，顺势为这一重全新蜕变的境界定下道号，自此开辟专属自身大道的无上境界。
他眸光澄澈笃定，心神紧扣自身道途，字字郑重，落定境界真谛：“以肉身载万法，以脊背龙骨承天地道初本源，此境，便称承法境。”
以身承法，以脊载道。
短短八字，道尽他整条逆天道途的核心本源，也彻底敲定了超脱万古、独一无二的肉身大道境界根基。
过往诸天修行，境由法定，皆循天地固有法理进阶；而词宋这承法境，是人定法、身载道，以己身容纳诸天法则，以龙骨贯通天地道韵，完全跳出天地桎梏，是真正意义上的自我为道、自我为法。
尘湮仙魂闻言微微颔首，空灵眼底满是赞许，悠悠仙音回荡山间：“承法境，三字贴切至极。”
词宋端坐青石之上，缓缓舒展周身筋骨，五道五脏道纹轮转不息，脊背二十四节龙骨道韵潺潺流淌，贯通肉身、神魂、天地三方，周身气息沉稳浩瀚、圆满无漏。
踏入承法境的他，不再依托任何外物、任何固有法理，自身便是最圆满的道，自身便是最本源的法。天地灵气随心而归，诸天法则随念而动，一言一行、一举一动，皆合道初本源真谛。
心绪落定，道境圆满。
词宋缓缓收势，双膝离石，身姿挺拔如青松凌云，自断崖青石之上稳稳站起身来。
一身衣袂被山间残余的时空仙风轻轻拂动，猎猎作响，周身萦绕的五色道韵、道初本源法则尽数敛归体内，融入脊背二十四节龙骨与五脏道纹闭环之中，不显半分磅礴异象，只余一身温润沉凝、深不可测的平淡气机，看似寻常，却已肉身载法、自身成道。
无需刻意推演，无需凝神探寻。
就在他立身起身的刹那，通体圆满的脊背龙骨骤然轻轻震颤，贯通周身的道初法则本能共鸣，轰然链接整片天元大陆深埋地底的所有仙脉本源。
嗡——
一缕苍茫古老、沉寂万古的地脉讯息，顺着法则通道瞬间冲入识海，清晰无比、分毫毕现。

词宋眸光微亮，脑海中瞬间浮现出一方辽阔苍茫的天地图景。
东极之地，沧海无垠，碧波万顷吞纳日月，海潮奔涌横贯八方。那是天元大陆疆域尽头的终极瀚海，常年风暴肆虐、乱流纵横，海域深处暗藏无尽时空乱流与地脉禁阻，是人迹罕至、大能止步的荒芜绝境。
第八道仙脉，亦是天元大陆境内最后一道封存仙脉，正深深蛰伏于极东无尽之海的万丈渊底。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Is Confucianism and Taoism supreme? I'm reciting Tang poetry in another world! Volume 1: Default Chapter 2158 Inheriting the Dharma with one’s body, carrying the Tao with one’s spine, and inheriting the Dharma Realm (..la) In an instant, all the sadness in Ci Song’s heart dissipated, and he completely saw clearly the true defiance of his own unique way.
Orthodox practice involves fighting for opportunities, understanding, luck, and hard work. It is shackles at every step, and every step is difficult. Lifespan is limited. Most monks are trapped in their realms throughout their lives, dying of old age and regrets.
As for his method of physical Taoist patterns, although the threshold is high, there is no need to compete for the destiny of heaven and earth, and no need to practice hard to break through the realm. He only needs to concentrate on polishing the body and engraving Taoist patterns, and he can exchange for a long lifespan several times that of monks of the same level.
For countless monks in the world who are stuck in the shortcomings of longevity and have stopped before the holy realm, this heaven-defying gift is an unparalleled opportunity and the dawn of the road, which is enough for countless geniuses to abandon their prejudices, not be afraid of difficulties, and devote themselves to practicing this method.
After figuring out the key here, Ci Song's eyes regained clarity, and his Taoist heart became more determined and transparent.
Thinking of this, Ci Song suddenly understood in his heart, combined with his current perfect state of practice, he took advantage of the situation to define a new realm of transformation, and since then opened up a supreme realm of his own path.
His eyes were clear and determined, his mind was closely focused on his own path, and he solemnly settled on the true meaning of the realm with each word: "The physical body carries all the dharma, and the dragon bones on the back carry the original origin of the heaven and earth. This state is called the state of inheriting the dharma."
Use your body to carry the Dharma, and your spine to carry the Dao.
The short eight characters revealed the core origin of his entire heaven-defying path, and also completely established the foundation of the eternal and unique realm of the physical body.
In the past, the practice of heaven and earth was based on laws and regulations, and all progressed according to the inherent laws of heaven and earth. However, in the Ci and Song Dynasties, the realm of inheriting laws is that people determine the law and carry the Tao in their bodies. They use their own bodies to accommodate the laws of the heavens, use the dragon bones to penetrate the rhythm of heaven and earth, and completely break out of the shackles of heaven and earth. It is the true sense of self-acting and self-acting.
Chen Yan's fairy soul nodded slightly when he heard the words, his ethereal eyes were full of approval, and the long fairy voice echoed in the mountain: "Inheriting the Dharma Realm, these three words are extremely appropriate."
Ci Song sat upright on the bluestone, slowly stretching his muscles and bones. The five internal organs are constantly rotating, and the twenty-four dragon bones on the back are flowing gurglingly, penetrating the body, soul, and heaven and earth. The breath of the whole body is calm, vast, and perfect.
When he enters the realm of inheriting the Dharma, he no longer relies on any external objects or any inherent legal principles. He himself is the most perfect Tao and the most original Dharma. The spiritual energy of heaven and earth returns with the heart, and the laws of the heavens move with the thought. Every word, every deed, and every move is in line with the true meaning of the original source of Tao.
The mind is settled and the Tao is complete.
Ci Song slowly withdrew his posture, his knees lifted off the stone, and his posture was as tall and straight as a green pine reaching into the clouds, and he stood up steadily from the blue stone on the cliff.
A suit of clothes was gently blown by the remaining fairy wind of time and space in the mountains, making a hunting sound. The five-color Taoist charm and the original law of Taochu that lingered around the body were all gathered into the body, integrated into the closed loop of the twenty-four keel bones on the back and the five internal organs. There was no majestic phenomenon, only a warm, calm, unfathomable and plain Qi. It seemed ordinary, but it had already carried the law in the body and achieved enlightenment on its own.
No need to deliberately deduce, no need to concentrate on exploration.
The moment he stood up, the keels of his perfect back suddenly trembled slightly, and the Daochu Law that penetrated his whole body instinctively resonated, suddenly connecting the origins of all the immortal veins buried deep in the entire Tianyuan Continent.
Buzz——
A wisp of vast, ancient and eternal earth-line information rushed into the sea of ​​consciousness along the passage of laws, with incomparable clarity and every detail.
Ci Song's eyes brightened slightly, and a vast and vast scene of heaven and earth suddenly appeared in his mind.
In the land of the East Pole, the sea is boundless, the blue waves swallow up the sun and the moon, and the tides rush across all directions. That is the ultimate vast sea at the end of the Tianyuan Continent. Storms rage all year round, and turbulent currents are everywhere. The depths of the sea hide endless turbulence of time and space and forbidden earth veins. It is a desolate and desperate situation that is inaccessible and where powerful powers can stop.
The eighth immortal vein is also the last seal in Tianyuan Continent.The immortal veins are dormant deep in the bottom of the endless sea in the far east.
